messages:
alex: Heads up — stumbled on a problem in /docs/runtime/quickstart.md: the curl example fails for me and the step numbering doesn't match the rest of the guide. Anyone able to patch? cc @maria

maria: Looking now. Can you paste the failing curl output or the exact snippet? If it's small I can push a quick fix this afternoon.

alex: Sure — here's the snippet and the curl output I saw:
```bash
curl -s -N "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1", "input":"hello"}'
# Expected streaming json, but the example uses --no-stream in text which prevents chunked responses
```

Also step 3 under "Run the example" is labeled "Start server" but the local dev server command is in step 4 now after the recent onboarding PR.

jin: I can take this. Small PR replacing the example with `curl --http2 -N` and renumbering sections? Will also add a one-line note about expected streaming behavior.

alex: That'd be great, thanks. Please also check the code snippet for the Authorization header — the sample used `API_KEY` in one spot and `$TOKEN` in another.

maria: Quick follow-up: can you open the PR targeting branch `docs/quickstart-cleanup` and add `closes #` referencing the issue? Also add a tiny test in docs CI that runs the curl command against the static sample (no auth) to avoid future regressions.

docs-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420 by jin. CI job docs-smoke now queued.

jin: PR is up — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1420. Added changelog note and updated step numbers. Left a TODO to refactor the streaming example into a standalone snippet file.

alex: LGTM on quick scan. :thumbsup: maria, can you approve once CI green? If small we can merge before end of day.

maria: Will review after lunch. If CI flakes, I'll push the small test tweak. Thanks everyone!
